story_first_trial.rationale: The accepted cut preserves six goalkeeper-rescue anchors. The largest uncovered gap remains between seg:1 and seg:2 (1966.45–3338.39). Prior trials in this gap were contradicted due to replay footage: interval_01:H5 (event_000397) and interval_01:H2 (event_000340, event_000367). Interval_01:H1 offers a different local sub-story in the same gap: repeated set-piece pressure (Corner_kick event_000285, Free_kick event_000311, Free_kick event_000337, Corner_kick event_000370). All four selected events are marked known_replay_or_slowmo=false, avoiding the prior replay contradictions. The proposed relation is explicitly non-causal narrative association, consistent with the template's temporal-episode-order structure. This selection contributes to the existing goalkeeper-rescue template by showing the recurring threat patterns that the goalkeeper repeatedly faces, without assuming unverified causality.
